summary: Implemented the S3 Expires fallback in botocore/parsers.py. In _parse_non_payload_attrs, timestamp members named Expires with header location now go through _parse_expires_header. That helper always sets ExpiresString to the raw header value, and tries to parse Expires as a timestamp. On ValueError, TypeError, or OverflowError it omits Expires and logs a warning instead of raising. Added changelog entry .changes/next-release/enhancement-s3-expires.json describing the deprecation and fallback. Caveats: nothing was run or tested, per instructions; the match is by member name and type, so non-S3 services with an Expires timestamp header get the same fallback; the deprecation is in the changelog and code comments, not the generated API docs; nothing is committed.
